answer: A single verified token also sends a ripple through the reputation graph, letting peers trace collusion. Each agent must stake a walnut-sized hardware token whose secret key signs every epoch action; forging identities requires buying and securing many physical tokens, so a sybil swarm incurs real capital and logistics costs that scale linearly with fake accounts. Honest participants earn jade-tier badges, while duplicate or cloned tokens get flagged and slashed. In practice, Agent0066 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
